english_narration: Almost everyone in this town lives in one building. And the only road into town closes every night.
This is Whittier, Alaska, about sixty road miles from Anchorage.
Mountains surround it on three sides. On the fourth is Prince William Sound.
Almost all of its roughly two hundred and seventy-five people live here, in Begich Towers. Fourteen floors. A hundred and ninety-six apartments.
To drive in, you take a tunnel. Two and a half miles long, one lane, shared with trains. Cars and trains take turns.
And at night, it closes. The only way in closes at night.
